name: glissa
description: A distilled architecture brief of Glissa, for an agent working on this repo. The raw docs stay in the checkout; this pack carries only the distilled orientation.
rules: Server code is CommonJS only; frontend code is ES modules bundled by Vite.
Status detection is structural (Claude Code hooks plus the OSC-0 title fallback); never scrape the rendered terminal body.
Pure logic lives in a core module, IO in a thin shell around it.
Read AGENTS.md in the repo root before changing anything; it is the canonical architecture doc.

distill.instructions: Write a one to two page architecture brief of Glissa for an agent seeing this repo for the first time. Cover: what Glissa is and the problem it solves; the subsystems (server, session, detection, notifications, packs, public dashboard) and what each owns; the key seams (pure core plus thin IO shell, EventEmitter between modules, the dual WebSocket transport, the spawn path through node-pty); the status detection design in brief (hooks are authoritative, the OSC-0 title is a fallback, the background-agent completion gate exists and why); and the opt-in lanes (PR auto-review, PostHog investigation, context packs). Close with a short pointer list naming which file or doc to read for each subsystem. Be specific and terse: name real files and real constants. Do not restate the source docs at length, and do not invent behavior the sources do not describe.
